resources.name: ORCA quantum chemistry package (version supporting SA-CASSCF/NEVPT2 and effective Hamiltonian ZFS)

access.notes: Free for academic use; other multi-reference packages (e.g. PySCF) are acceptable if they produce SA-CASSCF/NEVPT2 and effective Hamiltonian ZFS.
Structures are deposited in the Cambridge Structural Database (CCDC) and are available in the paper's electronic supplementary information.

resources.name: Computational resources (CPU cluster or cloud instance)

access.notes: The agent is responsible for acquiring sufficient compute to run multiple CASSCF/NEVPT2 jobs.
